QuantRule shell commands

  candles <csv-path>                                         Read one M1 CSV strictly and print its retained candles as NDJSON.
  candles-tolerant <csv-path>                                Read one M1 CSV tolerantly and print the retained candles plus a quality report.
  timeframes <csv-path>                                      Build every supported timeframe from one M1 CSV and print every retained series.
  events <csv-path> [--window full|latest]                   Print the flat model's registered and extended event records.
  report model --config <run.json> [--spec <spec.json>] [--out <dir>] [--json] Write the flat per-timeframe model bundle for one configured run.
  policy check --config <run.json>                           Validate the policy and every engine config against it.
  strategy explain --model <model-bundle> --strategy <strategy.json> --bar <index> [--position flat|long|short] Print one strategy decision and its as-of evidence from a model bundle.
  strategy run --model <model-bundle> --strategy <strategy.json> [--out <dir>] [--json] Write the strategy decisions bundle for one model bundle.
  execution run --decisions <strategy-bundle> --config <run.json> [--out <dir>] [--json] Turn a strategy decisions bundle into orders, fills, and rejections.
  portfolio replay --fills <execution-bundle> --config <run.json> [--out <dir>] [--json] Replay an execution fills bundle through portfolio accounting.
  backtest run --config <run.json> --strategy <strategy.json> [--out <dir>] [--json] Run the coupled model, strategy, execution, and portfolio stages.
  qualify --evidence <backtest-bundle> --criteria <qualification.json> [--out <dir>] [--json] Evaluate an evidence bundle against human-owned qualification criteria.
  analytics evaluate --evidence <backtest-bundle> [--out <dir>] [--json] Publish descriptive metrics and evaluation tables from a backtest bundle.
  fetch <symbol> <start> <end> [--timeframe <1m|5m|15m|1h>] [--csv <path>] Fetch a Dukascopy range and write the accepted candles as CSV.
  help [<command>|all|glossary]                              Print the command map, one command contract, or the glossary.

Type help <command> for the full contract, help all for every contract,
or help glossary for the precise-term glossary.
